# golden-set-builder

> Build golden evaluation datasets from production JSONL logs: dedup, regex PII scrubbing with typed placeholders, seeded stratified sampling, annotation files Python package `trysac-golden-set-builder`, import name `golden_set_builder`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
